title: Screaming-guinea-pig
author: Valderifs
changes: Pet guinea pig (Cavia porcellus) wheeking, the loud whistling squeal guinea pigs make when they ask for food. Trimmed to 11.62–13.86 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
